from rich.text import Text
import pytest

def test_append_tokens_none_content():
    text = Text()
    with pytest.raises(TypeError, match="Only str can be appended via append_tokens"):
        text.append_tokens([(None, None)])

def test_append_tokens_int_content():
    text = Text()
    with pytest.raises(TypeError, match="Only str can be appended via append_tokens"):
        text.append_tokens([(123, None)])

def test_append_tokens_control_codes():
    text = Text()
    # \x00 is a control code and should be stripped
    text.append_tokens([("\x00hello", None)])
    assert text.plain == "hello"
    assert len(text) == 5

def test_append_tokens_valid():
    text = Text()
    text.append_tokens([("hello", "red"), (" world", "blue")])
    assert text.plain == "hello world"
    assert len(text) == 11
